title: still present since round 4: report_download_test pins the id mapping but not baked-asset presence — a deleted/misnamed PDF 404s silently
detail: The test only round-trips ids against demo_store.report_filenames(); nothing asserts the eight files exist under server/priv/static/demo/, so a renamed/deleted asset passes green.
recommended_fix: Add a check that each pair's file exists in server/priv/static/demo/report-<id>.pdf (simplifile.is_file in a server-side or integration test).

title: still present since round 4: demo_flow_test header claims bug-hunt E2E coverage that does not exist; demo_requests_are_intercepted_test cannot distinguish demo from real dispatch
evidence: Header: "//// resolves it. The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution." — no scenario under .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/ exercises /demo (the only 'demo' hit is workflows/seed-applicants.yaml:15: "populate a demo/staging vacancy with diverse applicants."); demo_requests_are_intercepted_test asserts `case dash.vacancies { Loading -> Nil _ -> should.fail() }` — update_inner's real AppRequestedDashboardData arm also sets `vacancies: Loading` before its api call.
detail: The claimed E2E backstop doesn't exist, and the Loading assertion passes under either dispatch — the interception proof rests on the lint alone.
recommended_fix: Add a bug-hunt demo scenario (banner visible, zero network) or drop the header claim; assert a demo-only model change (e.g. demo_store untouched by real dispatch) instead of Loading.

title: still present since round 4: pdf_prebake regen docs promise a positional CLI arg that main() never reads
detail: Following the documented regen command silently writes to ./priv/static/demo from whatever cwd, not the passed arg — the next re-bake lands in the wrong tree.
recommended_fix: Make main() read the positional arg (or fix the header to document RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR only).

title: still present since round 4: Aoife's baked PDF hides her phone (employer-email half fixed)
evidence: base_row: `    phone: None,` — row_aoife's GetApplicationDetailRow(..base, ...) overrides list contains landlord_ref_phone and employer_ref_phone but no `phone:` override; the client fixture carries `"phone":"087 123 4567"` for a-aoife.
detail: The showcase applicant's phone renders in the SPA detail page but is absent from her downloadable report — the two surfaces disagree.
recommended_fix: Add `phone: Some("087 123 4567"),` to row_aoife's overrides and re-bake.

title: still present since round 4: Marta's baked report carries 5-of-6 category scores (rental_history missing)
detail: The real scoring pipeline always emits six categories; Marta's report renders a five-slice chart, inconsistent with every other baked report.
recommended_fix: Add a rental_history score for Marta (low, e.g. 30 — never rented in Ireland) and re-bake.

title: still present since round 4: copy.gleam demo constants inserted between the resend-confirmation comment and the constants it documents
detail: The resend-confirmation section comment is separated from its four constants by the entire demo block; readers mis-attribute the doc.
recommended_fix: Move the demo constants below the resend-confirmation block (or relocate the comment).

title: still present since round 4: policy_reaccept_required's doc block detached onto clear_demo_state
detail: policy_reaccept_required's six-line doc now reads as clear_demo_state's; the real function's contract lives above an unrelated fn.
recommended_fix: Insert a blank comment line (or move the block) so each doc attaches to its own fn.

title: still present since round 4: maples/harbour fixtures — created_at + validity_days != closes_at (36d vs 14d; 31d vs 21d)
evidence: v-maples: "validity_days":14,"max_applications":30,"created_at":"2026-07-20T10:00:00Z","closes_at":"2026-08-25T23:59:00Z" (Jul 20 +14d = Aug 3, not Aug 25 — 36 days); v-harbour: "validity_days":21,..."created_at":"2026-08-02T14:30:00Z","closes_at":"2026-09-02T23:59:00Z" (31 days); v-sunningdale's 30d does check out (Jun 15 → Jul 15).
detail: The listing window implied by created_at + validity_days contradicts closes_at for two of three fixtures; create_vacancy's own rule is closes_at = created_at + validity_days.
recommended_fix: Reconcile the two fixture closes_at values to created_at + validity_days (or bump validity_days to match).

title: still present since round 4: EXEMPT_ARMS trusts comments over code for 17 arms — removing a claimed guard keeps the lint green
evidence:
# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode
# (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are
# demo-guarded at the top of their handlers).
EXEMPT_ARMS = {
    "ApiReturnedLogin",
    "UserSubmittedLogin",
    ... "ApiReturnedSession",
    "ApiReturnedPolicyRefresh",
}
detail: The exemption rationale lives only in comments; nothing verifies e.g. UserClickedResendConfirmation truly exits the demo before its api call — deleting that exit stays lint-green.
recommended_fix: For the two guard-claimed arms, verify the `case model.demo_mode` exists in-scope (same matcher); for auth arms, assert demo_update.handle intercepts or auth is NotAsked-gated.

title: still present since round 4: manifest matcher counts any capitalized constructor line in handle bodies as 'handled' (theoretical masking)
detail: A capitalized constructor used as a value inside a nested case body (not a msg pattern) also matches, so DEMO_INTERCEPTED subset checks can pass on non-pattern lines.
recommended_fix: Track case-arm depth and only collect patterns at the outer case's subject level.

title: still present since round 4: seed_error_from_result discards the DecodeError — the drift guard can't say which fixture/field rotted
detail: A fixture decode failure reports a generic message with no field path; debugging a drift means bisecting four seed functions by hand.
recommended_fix: Carry json.DecodeError's path into SeedError (format it into the message).

title: still present since round 4: pdf_prebake payloads duplicate the client fixture stories across two packages with no mechanical consistency check
detail: The W12 class of drift (fixture changed, PDF stale) can recur silently — consistency rests on the comment.
recommended_fix: Add a shared-package test asserting the pdf_prebake payload incomes/scores match the client fixture decode for each applicant id.

title: still present since round 4: demo_analytics FFI documents props carrying fixture ids, but the only Gleam entry point hardcodes '{}'
detail: Every fired event carries empty props — the documented fixture-id/surface enrichment never happens, so demo funnel analysis can't split by surface.
recommended_fix: Add a props-taking variant (capture_event_with) used by the surface call sites, or fix the docs.

title: still present since round 4 (narrowed — demo-banner presence itself is covered): shell demo chrome details and landing demo anchors have no render coverage
evidence: demo_flow_test asserts `html |> string.contains("demo-banner") |> should.be_true` — but no test covers the demo-mode settings-link hiding (shell.gleam:107 `case model.demo_mode {`), the `copy.demo_exit_label` swap (299, 427), or the landing nav-try-demo anchor (landing.gleam:91, 207); all breadcrumb tests pass `demo: False` (client_test.gleam:792).
detail: The demo chrome's distinctive behaviours (hidden settings link, 'Exit demo' label, breadcrumb /demo home) can regress silently.
recommended_fix: Extend the simulate-based demo render test to assert demo_exit_label text, absent settings link, and breadcrumb home=/demo.

title: still present since round 4: demo_create_vacancy_mutates_store_test binds 'before' only to discard it
detail: The 'before' binding suggests a missing pre/post assertion (e.g. ids differ); as written it's dead weight ending in `let _ = before`.
recommended_fix: Assert something against before (e.g. dashboard length 2 -> 3) or drop the binding.

title: still present since round 4: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store, skipping the empty-ids guard
detail: A landlord with real comparison ids in localStorage who deep-links a demo /compare gets those REAL applicant ids resolved against the demo store — Ok for 'a-*' demo ids, Error-404-toast for real UUIDs at boot.
recommended_fix: Seed the demo entry's comparison fetch with empty ids (or ids filtered to the demo fixtures).
